topics.topic: How standing grants are tied to flow-version active state, including deactivation/reactivation and grant/revoke preconditions
questions: If a granted flow version is deactivated and later activated again, does its prior active grant still apply, or is it auto-revoked when the version stops being active?
Must grant/revoke be refused unless the referenced flow version is currently active for its flow?

topics.topic: What revoke should return/do when no active standing grant exists
questions: What is the revoke result if there is no active grant for that node/version (never granted or already revoked)?
What must happen when revoke is called but there is no active grant for that flow-version node (never granted, or already revoked)?

topics.topic: How EffectAttempt/approval/grant records are exposed for reading (inspect scope and other product actions)
questions: Through which product action can owner/agent read EffectAttempt facts (especially idempotency_key), if at all?
Is inspect intentionally limited to those four subjects, or does it also include approvals/grants (and possibly effect attempts)?

topics.topic: How SpooledFile.disclosure_class is determined for files produced by function/operation nodes
questions: What rule sets a spooled file's disclosure_class when produced by function or operation nodes?

topics.topic: How run start targets flow versions and what happens if no active version exists
questions: Does run start accept only a flow name and always use its active version, or may it target a specific flow version, and what is the refusal when no active version exists?

topics.topic: Run status precedence when multiple wait reasons coexist (owner approval and outcome_unknown/service_unreachable)
questions: If a run simultaneously has an `owner_approval` wait and an `outcome_unknown` (or `service_unreachable`) wait on another node, which single run status is required?

topics.topic: What Slot.current_implementation is when no implementation has ever been activated
questions: What is the slot's "current implementation" when the latest contract version has no activation yet (for example, empty corpus or no admitted implementation)?

topics.topic: Whether Flow.purpose is mutable after flow creation across later versions
questions: After flow creation, can `purpose` ever change when composing later versions under the same flow name?

topics.topic: Whether Slot.purpose is mutable after slot creation
questions: After slot creation, can `purpose` ever change (for example on later contract-author calls for the same slot)?

topics.topic: Whether composing duplicate flow content reuses an existing FlowVersion versus creating/updating a new one (and authorship consequences)
questions: When an agent composes content equal to an existing flow version, is the existing version returned (keeping original authored_by/authored_at), or is any new record created/updated?

topics.topic: Whether unused EffectApprovals auto-close to a terminal state when the run ends
questions: If the run ends (`cancelled`, `failed`, or `refused`) while an approval is still `requested` or `approved` but unused, does approval status stay as-is forever or transition to a terminal closed state?
